# Release limitations, and why this candidate is not tagged

A tag is created only when every declared gate passes. It does not, so there is no
`v0.2.0-rc1` tag on this commit, and this file says exactly which gates hold and which do
not. Hiding an unmet gate would be the one thing a release candidate must not do.

## The gates

| gate | status | evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Data | **met** | historical-core-v1 names 7 inputs with their SHA-256, states its rights, and its coverage report `docs/v2/coverage-historical-core-v1.md` is in the tree |
| Outcome | **met** | the protocol pre-registers 9 primary outcomes with a minimum substantive effect on 9 of them and 4 declared windows; the band names 8 reading lines |
| Calibration | **unmet** | the frozen posterior records converged=false: location moved 0.449 of the prior range; acceptance 1.000, against a declared location_change_max of 0.1 (measured 0.4491534951297869, acceptance [1.0, 1.0]) |
| Sensitivity | **unmet** | 4 of 4 rungs did not settle: morris: the trajectory bootstrap reproduced the top-4 set in 0.00 of resamples; morris: the trajectory bootstrap reproduced the top-4 set in 0.01 of resamples; sobol: the first level: nothing to compare it with; sobol: the largest S1 move against the previous level was 12.071 |
| Intervention | **met** | all 28 arms that declare an effect report a configuration diff; the 12 arms declared to reproduce the reference are reported by the no-op detector, which returned 9 verdicts |
| Hold-out | **met** | all 4 V1 hold-out failures carry a classification, and the freeze gate refuses a reserved-window score without the posterior hash |
| Policy | **unmet** | the runtime layer runs and refuses nothing it should not, but the arm made 0 model decisions on the historical core: its prompt is outside the fixture corpus, so M2 is incomplete and the arm is a pilot |
| Provenance | **met** | all 6 cards carry model evidence with an artifact digest and a lineage from a source to the card, and every lineage locator resolves |
| Release | **met** | the bundle binds the commit, the lock, the artifacts, the reports and the translation version, each with its SHA-256 |

**6 of 9 gates are met.** The unmet ones are carried as limitations rather than closed by argument:

- **Calibration** — the frozen posterior records converged=false: location moved 0.449 of the prior range; acceptance 1.000, against a declared location_change_max of 0.1 (measured 0.4491534951297869, acceptance [1.0, 1.0])
- **Sensitivity** — 4 of 4 rungs did not settle: morris: the trajectory bootstrap reproduced the top-4 set in 0.00 of resamples; morris: the trajectory bootstrap reproduced the top-4 set in 0.01 of resamples; sobol: the first level: nothing to compare it with; sobol: the largest S1 move against the previous level was 12.071
- **Policy** — the runtime layer runs and refuses nothing it should not, but the arm made 0 model decisions on the historical core: its prompt is outside the fixture corpus, so M2 is incomplete and the arm is a pilot

## What may still be released, and how

The tag is withheld; the artifacts are not. Every document this phase generated is
reproducible offline from the tree, and the release bundle records the digests that make the
unmet gates checkable rather than asserted.
